name: Dailymotion
description: Trending, your chosen channels, categories and search from Dailymotion's public API. Plays in Dailymotion's official player.
author: Fanoos

settings.label: Dailymotion player ID
settings.help: Needed by Dailymotion's player. Free: sign in at dailymotion.com/partner → Players → Create a player → copy its ID (looks like x1ab2). Enable Autoplay in its settings.

settings.label: Channels (usernames or links)
settings.help: Separate with commas. Example: https://www.dailymotion.com/france24, euronews

settings.label: Category rows (comma separated)
settings.help: Dailymotion channel ids, e.g. news, sport, music, videogames, fun, tv, kids, tech, animals, auto

settings.label: Country for Trending (optional)
settings.help: Two-letter code, e.g. MA, FR. Empty = worldwide
